subject: Demo failure: opaque header dropped on routing fallback — ask for SDK/runtime change
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Alex Choi <alex.choi@finai.com>
Cc: procurement@finai.com
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Demo failure: opaque header dropped on routing fallback — ask for SDK/runtime change

Hi all,

Quick heads-up: during yesterday's FinAI UAT/demo the generation dropped into a fallback pool and FinAI reported repeated session replays (same conversation ID appearing across simultaneous sessions). On our end the logs show the custom opaque header X-FINAI-SESSION being present at the edge but not forwarded when the request was routed to a warm fallback node. That header is how FinAI correlates requests client-side; without it they saw duplicated responses and their UI retried, creating doubled token charges.

This is blocking the scheduled demo next week unless we ship either a short-term mitigation (runtime forward of opaque headers during fallback) or an SDK flag that instructs the client to put session correlation into the request body instead.

Ask: can Platform/Runtime triage and propose a short-term hotfix (ETA and risk), and Product/SDK propose a small API/SDK change we can ship quickly (opt-in) to preserve session correlation for customers that rely on opaque headers? FinAI is sensitive to any change that might affect latency so we'd prefer minimal surface area.

What I can offer from Sales Eng: a reduced-scope canary account (FinAI staging) and a short repro package — attaching the demo recording and a repro trace. Please let me know owners and next steps; I need a plan to present to FinAI's CTO today.

Thanks,

Tessa Morgan
Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
(t) 415-555-0143

Attachments: repro_trace.tar.gz (logs + minimal repro), demo_screens.mp4 (screen capture of FinAI UI)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Choi <alex.choi@finai.com>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Demo failure: opaque header dropped on routing fallback — ask for SDK/runtime change

Thanks Tessa — good catch and very actionable. Initial thoughts from runtime side:

- The smart-routing fallback currently reconstructs the request at the gateway layer and intentionally strips non-standard headers for safety. That's likely why X-FINAI-SESSION is missing on the warm node.
- Short-term hotfix: we can add a whitelist rule (config) to preserve headers that match X-FINAI-* for specific customer routes. That is low-risk and could be rolled as a config change to the gateway (no binary change), ETA ~48 hours for canary.
- Medium-term: runtime should carry a metadata envelope (request_metadata) that persists across routing decisions. That requires a small schema change and coordination with the SDK to escalate an opt-in flag (e.g., preserveOpaqueHeaders: true) that serializes selected headers into the envelope. ETA 3-4 sprints for spec + rollout.

Questions:
1) Tessa — can you confirm which header names FinAI relies on and whether they can switch to a JSON body field temporarily?
2) Marissa/Ben — I'll need a small test harness and a reproducer that triggers fallback deterministically so we can validate the gateway whitelist before the demo.

I'll pick up the gateway config change if Ben can help me validate.

- Karthik
Principal SW Eng, Runtime

On a related note: we should evaluate whether other customers rely on arbitrary opaque headers — if yes, defaulting to 'drop' may be breaking more demos than we realize. I recommend a short audit (log search) after the patch.

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Alex Choi <alex.choi@finai.com>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 15:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Demo failure: opaque header dropped on routing fallback — ask for SDK/runtime change

Quick triage results (repro attached):

- Repro steps (summary):
  1) Client posts request with X-FINAI-SESSION set to a UUID.
  2) Gateway selects primary pool, then intentionally routes one of the concurrent requests to fallback due to simulated token spike.
  3) Warm node receives request without X-FINAI-SESSION; runtime assigns new internal conversation id.
  4) FinAI UI receives mismatched conversation id and performs retry, causing duplicate token accounting.

- Logs: the gateway scrub step strips headers matching non-standard prefix. See attached repro_trace.tar.gz for logs (gateway and node trace).
- Quick mitigation I implemented in the lab: added a config entry to gateway "preserve_headers_prefixes": ["X-FINAI-"]. With that change, warm node receives header and FinAI flow is correct. No runtime binary changes required. I ran the FinAI repro 20x and didn't see duplication.

Plan:
- I can push the gateway config to our staging canary (RW-staging-03) tomorrow morning. Karthik — please confirm who will validate on the warm node side.
- For the SDK: Ben proposes a tiny opt-in flag in JS + Python SDKs (preserveOpaqueHeaders: ["X-FINAI-SESSION"]) that serializes specified headers into request_metadata when present. That reduces reliance on gateway rules for customers who bundle across CDNs.

Notes: attaching repro_trace.tar.gz (30MB) and a short screen capture demo_screens.mp4.

-ben
Ben Carter
Senior Software Engineer, Runtime

Attachments: repro_trace.tar.gz, demo_screens.mp4

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Choi <alex.choi@finai.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Demo failure: opaque header dropped on routing fallback — ask for SDK/runtime change

This sounds good — thanks team. Quick customer update I gave FinAI: we can do a bounded canary in your staging account (Tessa to provide creds) and aim to have the gateway config live in staging by tomorrow EOD. If that validates, we will enable the same config for the FinAI demo account with a controlled window during their UAT next Tues.

Action items:
- Tessa: drop FinAI staging creds into the Drive link (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1FinAI-demo-artifacts) and include any scripted test vectors.
- Ben/Karthik: roll the gateway preserve_headers_prefixes config to RW-staging-03 and ping me when validated.
- SDK/Product: open a lightweight RFC for the preserveOpaqueHeaders opt-in flag and back-compat notes; I can prioritize a one-week shipping lane if we commit to an experimental flag in JS and Python.

I'll own the customer comms and schedule the controlled window. Tessa, I'll be on the call for the demo.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

On the call with FinAI CTO: they prefer the gateway config path as the fastest way, but want the SDK flag as a future-proof fallback.
